intro: On Nov 14, 2026, an AI agent drafted this page from its sources as fetched at the time. Separate AI checkers, which never saw the drafting, then checked it: each sentence against the passages it cites, one whole-page read against all the passages, and fairness reviews from each side's seat. In this trial, no person checked the facts. Here is what the checkers did, what they found, and what is still open.

sections.title: What we checked
paras: Code confirmed that every sentence cites a source passage or is labeled as our analysis, that quotes match word for word, that numbers appear in the cited passages, that reading level and length limits are met, and that no private person's name or street address appears.

A separate AI checker judged each sentence against only the passages it cites. To test that checker, 11 sentences with planted errors were mixed in without telling it; it caught all 11 and wrongly flagged none of 20 clean ones.
One checker then read the whole page against every passage, giving the exact words that support each sentence; code confirmed those words are in the passages.

A panel of three reviewers read the first draft: one for VoltaGrid's positions, one for the people who filed and the parties opposing dismissal, and a neutral editor. After the fixes, a fourth reviewer read the page from each side's seat.

sections.title: What's still open
items: 5 low-severity fairness notes and 16 low-severity wording notes from the whole-page read were not acted on.
The 30-second version names the Hearing Officer before the page explains the term.
The docket page shows a date of July 2, 2026 beside a petition filed July 13, 2026. We did not use the earlier date and have not explained the difference.
The first fairness panel's medium and low notes that were not fixed are in the review record.

sections.title: What this can't do
paras: We read the long filings in excerpts found by keyword search, so a point made only outside those excerpts can be missing.
Two orders are images with no readable text, including the Chairman's Nov 12 order, and one piece of testimony could not be downloaded. The page says so where it matters.
The checkers are AI models. They catch planted errors reliably, but a subtle overstatement can pass, and fairness is a judgment.

stateLine: Every sentence on this page has a current check. A sentence is checked again whenever it or its source changes.
